svg.title: Actuary — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as actuary, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A probability curve is clearly separated from its chart axes above a sparse three-column observation table. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
